text:
deploy-bot: Rolling soft-unpin for runtime v6.0 -> v6.1 in us-central-1 starting 07:00 PT. Targets: mistral-mini-q, gptx-micro. Rollout plan: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m holds. Auto-pinback enabled. See playbook: https://go/redwood/ops/unpin-v6 :sparkles:

rafael: Heads-up: v6.1 reorders multi-head attention kernels for quantized paths. We saw a p95 spike in microbenchmarks for mistral-mini-q at seq=1536 (~+13%).

kim: Is that across all hosts or single-host noise? We need canary numbers before advancing.

rafael: Two hosts in canary pool reproducible. Tradeoff: ~15% token-cost savings in steady-state.

dotan: SDK note: clients on sdk-2.9 will drop when the new routing header `x-rw-route-v` is present. There are ~3 routes in us-central-1 still on 2.9 (>200rps). We should exclude them from canary.

ops: Ops checklist:
1) Start canary 5% in us-central-1
2) Attach probes: latency.p95, errors, host.mem, kv-cache.hit
3) Abort if p95 delta > 10% OR errors >0.5% OR mem increase >200MB
4) Rollback: infractl rollback --runtime v6.1 --region us-central-1
5) Pinback: infractl pin --runtime v6.0 --model mistral-mini-q

ci-bot: Suggest auto-exclude rule: `route.exclude_if sdk_version ~ "^2\.9"`. I can apply to canary groups on go. Confirm?

kim: Apply exclude. Also shadow sdk-2.9 traffic for 20m to capture failures.

deploy-bot: Exclude rule applied at 6501234575. Shadow job started. Canary 5% started at 6501234577. Telemetry hooks attached.

rafael: Canary update 6501234588: mistral-mini-q p95 +11.6%, errors 0.04%, mem +90MB, kv-cache.hit -2%. Same signal on two hosts. gptx-micro looks stable.

kim: p95 under 10% threshold? It's >10% but <12%. Threshold is 10% so we should pause and inspect. I prefer a pause + quick micro-optimizer vs full rollback.

dotan: Agree. Also follow-up: we must notify the 3 sdk-2.9 customers about shadowing. Jess in CSM to draft? (mentioning jess out-of-band)

ops: Recommend staged: pause, collect flamegraphs and traces (10m), if micro-opt patch available in ~30-45m apply and re-run 5% canary. If no patch, rollback mistral-mini-q only and continue for gptx-micro.

deploy-bot: Action: paused rollout at 6501234590 (pause id 6501234567-paused). To abort fully reply `abort` or run `deploy-bot pause 6501234567`.

rafael: I'll capture traces and open ticket INC-6501-quant-kernel with logs & repro. If we can land micro-optimizer quickly we can re-try today.

kim: Thanks. I will coordinate CSM messages and confirm sdk routing exclusion status.

ops: Noted. We'll prepare pinback script in case we need instant rollbacks.

deploy-bot: Final note: automated fallback will pin back model-group on threshold breach. Reply `resume` to continue after fixes or `abort` to cancel.
